cohort: Pregnant women in two secondary care hospitals in Limbe and Buea, Cameroon
finding: The prevalence of fibroids in pregnancy was 16.7%, and pregnant women with leiomyoma were more likely to experience acute abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, cesarean birth, low Apgar score, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was significantly associated with the presence of leiomyoma in pregnancy (OR 4.5; 95% CI 1.4-13.6, p = 0.008).
